items.question: Which streams of alternative medicine can medical care be acquired in under the UAE Traditional, Complementary and Alternative Medicine (TCAM) professional licence?
items.gold: Ayurveda, Chiropractic Medicine, Homeopathy, Naturopathic Medicine, Osteopathic Medicine, Therapeutic Massage, Traditional Chinese Medicine and Unani Medicine.
items.fact: TCAM licence covers eight alternative medicine streams, listed explicitly

items.question: Does the UAE issue a professional licence in Traditional, Complementary and Alternative Medicine (TCAM)?
items.gold: Yes, the UAE issues a professional licence in the fields of TCAM.
items.fact: UAE issues professional licence for Traditional, Complementary and Alternative Medicine
